notes: New family-standard screen: pinned green header with app name and version, scrollable cards starting right under the header, and a pinned footer bar. One-time welcome card explains the four spoken alerts; completing it is stored on the phone. Larger full-width Turn on/off button and large steppers. Behavior unchanged: English Connected, Disconnected, Full charge and Low battery announcements; low-battery threshold default 15%, adjustable 5-50% in 5% steps; announcements only when turned on, with the screen off and no active media. CI unit/platform and native UI tests passed. Physical installation, spoken-audio and OEM media behavior have not yet been verified.
